TO: ports@openbsd.org
SUBJECT: NEW: multimedia/graft 0.2.2

-----BODY-----
Please consider importing this new port.

graft is a local-first composition workspace. Incremental compiler
for video. Git owns recipe history; graft owns scions, layers, and
compile. Runtime ffmpeg via shell-out (graphics/ffmpeg). Build with
lang/rust.

  https://github.com/eonik-ai/graft
  https://github.com/eonik-ai/graft/releases/tag/v0.2.2

I do not have a ports CVS login. Happy to adjust the Makefile if a
committer wants to import it.

crates.io crate name graft is a different program (orbitinghail).
This source is github.com/eonik-ai/graft.

Comment:	Change the hook. Keep the body.
WWW:		https://github.com/eonik-ai/graft

diff follows.

--- /dev/null
+++ multimedia/graft/Makefile
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+COMMENT =	Change the hook. Keep the body.
+
+DISTNAME =	graft-0.2.2
+
+CATEGORIES =	multimedia
+
+HOMEPAGE =	https://github.com/eonik-ai/graft
+
+MAINTAINER =	Abinash Senapati <abinashsena@gmail.com>
+
+# Apache 2.0
+PERMIT_PACKAGE =	Yes
+
+WANTLIB +=	c pthread
+
+BUILD_DEPENDS =	lang/rust
+RUN_DEPENDS =	graphics/ffmpeg
+
+SITES =		https://github.com/eonik-ai/graft/archive/refs/tags/
+DISTFILES =	v0.2.2.tar.gz
+
+WRKDIST =	${WRKDIR}/graft-0.2.2
+
+do-build:
+	cd ${WRKSRC} && cargo build --release --locked --bin graft
+
+do-install:
+	${INSTALL_PROGRAM} ${WRKSRC}/target/release/graft ${PREFIX}/bin/
+
+.include <bsd.port.mk>
